resources.string: Android did not report a single media output, so processing and editing are paused. Pick one output in the system media controls.
Processing is paused for external outputs. Switch back to the built-in speakers and turn off \"Off while using headphones\" to use per-device settings.
Changes are saved for this device only. Left/right stay fixed when the screen rotates. New devices start with processing off and a flat profile.
This device has no unique address, so it is identified by type and name. Identically named devices and passive wired headphones may share one profile.
